_meta.source: Razorpay's live-mode payment error documentation, read 2026-09-01, plus the test-card page read 2026-08-31 and this project's own observations.

labels.documented-live: A string Razorpay publishes as live-mode vocabulary. Cited by the source field on the row.
labels.documented-test-mode: A string the Razorpay test-card page carries. It may or may not be live-mode vocabulary, and where it differs from the live spelling the row says so.
labels.observed-test-mode: A string this project observed coming back from Razorpay test mode and which appears on no documentation page.

kind_values.reason: a payment-failure reason string returned in error.reason for a failed payment
kind_values.error_class: a top-level Razorpay error class returned in error.code

_meta.method_values: card or upi for a reason, empty for an error class. Razorpay documents its failure reasons per method and the two lists are not the same list.
_meta.error_source: The nine documented values of error.source are in internal/classify as the Source type, sourced from https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-gateway/rainy-day/errors/payment-error-parameters/. error.step has no published enumeration on the same page and stays a free string.
_meta.network_codes: The Visa Category 1 and Mastercard merchant advice code lists are in internal/networkcodes, not here. They are card-network rules with their own sources, and they are not Razorpay vocabulary.
_meta.read_by: TestClassifierIsTotalOverKnownRazorpayErrorCodes asserts the classifier returns a class for every code listed here and never panics. TestErrorCodeFileLabelsEveryEntry asserts every row carries a label from _meta.labels and a source, and that a documented-live reason is in the classifier's table for the method it names.
_meta.live_observation_2026_08_31: Every one of the eight documented test cards, driven through the only mechanism that makes a test-mode payment attempt happen, came back with error.reason payment_failed and error.code BAD_REQUEST_ERROR. Not one documented reason string was produced. docs/RAZORPAY-TEST-MODE-NOTES.md has the walk.
_meta.production_observation_2026_09_01: A read-only probe of the author's own live Razorpay merchant account, covering 2026-07-15 to 2026-08-31, returned two payments: one captured UPI payment of 69900 paise and one failed UPI payment of 178800 paise carrying error_code BAD_REQUEST_ERROR, error_reason payment_timed_out, error_source customer, and error_step payment_authentication. That single failure confirms three things: a documented live-mode reason string does appear in production, the documented error_source enum does appear in production, and the coarse-code-plus-specific-reason structure holds outside test mode. It is one payment. It is a specimen, not a distribution, and no share, rate, or mix in this repository is derived from it. Aggregate fields only; no payload from that account is published.
_meta.pending_reason: payment_failed names no cause, so there is no basis on which to call a retry eligible and no honest class to give it. It falls to the fail-closed Unclassified default, which is asserted by TestClassifierLeavesTheObservedLiveReasonUnclassified rather than left implicit.
